name: Safe Retreat (Combat)
body:
You can take advantage ofan opening when you cast spells while threatened.

Prerequisite(s): Combat Casting, Spellcraft 5 ranks.

Benefit: When you successfully cast a spell defensively, your movement until your next turn doesn’t provoke attacks of opportunity from any creatures that were threatening you when you cast defensively. (The movement still provokes attacks of opportunity from other creatures normally.)
